technologies.title: Beyond software
technologies.summary: My interests extend beyond software into data analysis, electronics, and hands-on experimental work. I enjoy projects where software interacts with the physical world.

focus.title: Current focus
focus.summary: I build web applications and software systems while expanding into data analysis, IoT, and physical prototyping. I’m particularly interested in projects that connect software with real-world experimental problems.

projectDescriptions.robe: Product-focused web experience for a professional lighting manufacturer, built around clear product discovery and polished visual presentation.
projectDescriptions.kinedok: Platform for a documentary film network, helping visitors explore programs, venues and festival content across regions.
projectDescriptions.revizio: Application for managing inspection and revision workflows, with clearer records and smoother day-to-day administration.
projectDescriptions.mycopod: Experimental automated system for growing mushrooms in a controlled environment. It combines 3D design and printing, electronics, ESP32-based sensing and control, and custom software for monitoring cultivation data.
projectDescriptions.my213: Digital portal focused on simplifying structured business workflows, data entry and user-facing administration.
projectDescriptions.ondrasek: Presentation website for Ondrášek, focused on content structure, visual clarity and straightforward access to key information.
